title: botai policy decision
description: The answer to one question: may this help be given? The decision is produced by code from the accepted course contract, never by the model, and it names its reason. A refusal that cannot point at a rule is indistinguishable from an invented refusal, and a permission that cannot point at a rule is how a graded task quietly becomes practice.

decision.description: `needs_confirmation` is not a softer `allow`: it means the operation has an effect outside the session and a human must approve this exact plan.

reason_code.description: Stable machine code. Tests and callers branch on this, not on the message text.

assistance_ceiling.description: The highest level of help this intent may reach. null means no help may be given at all.

rule_ref.description: Which rule decided it — a contract field such as assignments[practice-diff].assessment, or a named policy rule. A decision with no rule_ref must not be trusted.

alternatives.description: What the agent may offer instead. A refusal without an alternative teaches nothing.
